firstPlayerRule: The player to the dealer’s left goes first, and play continues clockwise. That player also deals the next round.
houseFallback: The rules do not say who deals the first round; use the picker.
internalEvidence: Fetched the PlayMonster-hosted rules PDF listed on playmonster.com/rules-and-activity-guide/ and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 1: "The player to the dealer’s left goes first and play continues clockwise." "The player to the dealer’s left shuffles all of the cards and deals the next round."
uncertainty: The rules do not say how the first dealer is chosen.
